# units/kib

> n kib: kibibytes: 1024 bytes, as bytes.

truck [units](../units.md) · [source](../../../registry/units/kib.pkg)

```
print 4 kib  // 4096
```

Binds tighter than any operator, so `2 * 3 kib` is `2 * (3 kib)`.
See [units](../units.md).

## Syntax

Kind: `postfix`, precedence 90, left-associative

```
{n: expr int} kib -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `n` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`
